articles.title: Goldman Sachs brings $100 billion Treasury fund into crypto’s institutional plumbing
articles.snippet: The bank is bringing its roughly $100 billion Treasury fund to institutional crypto firms without creating a tokenized version of it.

articles.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
articles.snippet: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.

articles.title: Crypto-friendly institution Franklin Templeton brings its tokenized collateral service to Bybit
articles.snippet: Franklin Templeton’s tokenized money market shares can be used as collateral for USDT or USDC trading credit lines on Bybit while earning yield on the underlying assets.

articles.title: Eyes on key U.S. employment data as crypto bulls take a breather: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.snippet: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Sept. 28.

articles.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
articles.snippet: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.
